Plot supplied feeding-behaviour phases against a measured index

Source: R/publication-feeding-states.R
aqt_plot_feeding_states.Rd

Four-panel descriptive scatterplot comparing feeding scenarios. The function never infers feeding from speed, HMM state, or clustering alone: both the numerical index and biological phase labels MUST be supplied. Thus rendering the figure is not validation of a feeding index.

Usage

aqt_plot_feeding_states(
  data,
  scenario_col = "scenario",
  time_col = "time_min",
  index_col = "fbi",
  phase_col = "phase",
  event_time_min = 0,
  index_limits = c(0, 1),
  phase_colors = c(pre = "#24292F", onset = "#E53935", later = "#9CA3AF", post =
    "#3055EE")
)

Arguments

data

Nonempty data.frame with columns scenario,time_min,fbi,phase (or alternative names selected by column arguments).

scenario_col, time_col, index_col, phase_col

Column names.

event_time_min

Known intervention onset; default zero minutes.

index_limits

Numeric axis limits; default c(0,1) for a normalized fraction. Set NULL to infer observed limits.

phase_colors

Named vector of colour codes for the phase labels.

Value

Invisibly, a data.frame with observations per supplied phase and scenario; attributes explicitly state the labels are not verified.
